gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-002 concerns the covariance and standard-Wiener-process claim when the A- and Q-eigenbases do not coincide. It does not recognize the distinct degeneracy defect that zero covariance eigenvalues are admitted and make 1/sqrt(lambda_k) undefined, nor does it supply the zero-mode treatment required by the gold issue.

Both identify that, under only the separately stated assumptions, the normalization by lambda_k does not produce standard Wiener processes: the covariance need not be min(t,s) delta_kj unless the A-eigenvectors are also Q-eigenvectors. ISSUE-002 explicitly gives the covariance failure, a counterexample, and the repair of restricting standardness to the joint-eigenbasis assumption.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The coefficient processes omega_k are incorrectly asserted to be standard Wiener processes under assumptions that do not ensure Qe_k=lambda_k e_k; the required covariance normalization and independence are restored only under the joint-eigenbasis condition.

component_coverage.gold_component: Under only parts (i)-(ii), the covariance of the normalized coefficient processes need not equal min(t,s)delta_kj.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction computes the variance/covariance normalization failure and supplies a concrete non-joint-basis counterexample.

component_coverage.gold_component: The claimed standard Wiener-process and associated temporal estimates are therefore unsupported without the joint-eigenbasis condition.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction states that standardness is asserted from (i)-(ii) alone, moves that conclusion under assumption (iii), and identifies the corrected quadratic variation under the weaker assumptions.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: Both identify the incorrect propagation of the Weyl constant through the powers defining mu_k and lambda_k. The prediction gives the corrected C_Delta^alpha and C_Delta^{-beta} factors, derives the resulting exponent, and supplies the same corrected repair as the gold issue.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The Laplacian corollary misapplies the eigenvalue bounds by failing to raise C_Delta to the alpha and -beta powers, producing an unsupported Weyl-constant factor instead of C_Delta^{-beta-(2gamma-1)alpha}.

component_coverage.gold_component: The eigenvalue bounds must contain C_Delta^alpha and C_Delta^{-beta}, not unpowered C_Delta.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly derives both corrected eigenvalue bounds and identifies the printed powers as valid only in the special case C_Delta=1.

component_coverage.gold_component: Substitution into the general theorem yields C_Delta^{-beta-(2gamma-1)alpha}, so the displayed corollary constant is unsupported.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction computes the resulting corrected constant exponent and states that the corollary's displayed constant is wrong for admissible domains.
